question: Motion to Proceed to S.J.Res. 196
bill_title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Education relating to "Reimagining and Improving Student Education-Federal Student Loan Program Final Regulations".
plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up S.J.Res. 196, whose official title is “A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Education relating to "Reimagining and Improving Student Education-Federal Student Loan Program Final Regulations"”. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.

question: Motion to Invoke Cloture on the Motion to Proceed to S. 3627
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (47-45, 3/5 majority required)
plain_language: This vote would end debate on whether to take up S. 3627 (Pregnant Students’ Rights Act), which requires colleges that participate in federal student aid programs to give prospective and enrolled students information on rights and resources for pregnant students to carry a baby to term. Cloture needs 60 votes (three-fifths of the Senate). A Yea moves the Senate toward taking up the bill; a Nay keeps debate open.
